bpro.description: Led the frontend of a 12-module React and TypeScript ERP (150,000 lines) for mid-sized companies in the Gulf region, in Arabic and English with right-to-left layouts. Held alongside the government role until 05/2025.
highlights: Defined the frontend architecture, coding guidelines, and ESLint rules; final reviewer on all pull requests; mentored four junior developers and interviewed candidates.
Built the finance and payments module screens: chart of accounts, journal entries, tax filing, bank cheques, customer payments, and reconciliation.
Built page templates and a reusable component library adopted in over half of the 1,300+ module files.
Cut 10,000-row report rendering from about 20 seconds to under a second with pagination and list virtualization; reduced initial load with code splitting.
Built role-based access control (RBAC) end to end, from permission management screens to permission-filtered routes and navigation.
Built a PDF report engine on jsPDF that renders QtRPT XML templates with page bands, expressions, images, and barcodes.
Built the data layer with Redux Toolkit and RTK Query, tested with Jest and Cypress, and delivered through Jenkins CI/CD with Gitea in a Scrum team.
